case.summary: The case was triggered by a customer report stating they did not make the flagged $128.33 transaction, which exceeded their 95th-percentile amount and originated from a new device. Decisive evidence includes the cardholder confirming they still hold the card and did not authorize the purchase, alongside a fraud probability of 0.954 and connections to known fraud in the graph. It was assumed from the customer that the dispute is unprompted and no recurring or familiar-merchant match exists. The verdict is fraud, and the actions to block the card and create a case follow Fraud Policy R2 because the customer denied the transaction and the exposure is within policy limits.
